text:
sara: Weird one — florist just arrived with a large bouquet marked for "Town Hall" but no team listed. They want an onsite contact.
frontdesk-bot: @sara please provide a contact name for delivery acceptance. Locker A5 available for temporary holds. :package:

sara: Can reception hold it and I'll assign it to events. Also, can someone badge a vendor (GreenThumb AV) arriving at 13:30? They said they’ll be at lobby.
people-ops: We'll pre-print badges for GreenThumb AV. Please DM full name(s) for each technician and we'll print gold visitor badges (vendor) that must be returned. Reminder: vendor IDs required on arrival.

riley: Two techs: Miguel Santos and Priya Desai. They'll need access to 3rd floor staging and a dolly pass for elevator.
katie: Facilities can sign off on dolly/elevator access — @facilities please confirm. Also note the bouquet is large and might block the lobby flow if left near reception.

facilities: Confirmed — we'll move the bouquet to Locker A5 and leave a "Fragile - Events" tag. Dolly pass for Miguel & Priya approved from 13:25-14:00. Please have team escort them to the freight elevator.
courier-bot: Delivery logged: carrier 'BloomExpress', tracking BE-445566, received 11:08, stored in Locker A5.

sara: Thanks — I'll post someone to lobby at 13:20 to meet the techs and grab the bouquet if needed. Also quick note: if guests ask for network, please hand out 'VISITOR-2h' cards only for vendors requiring access.
people-ops: Noted. Badges will be printed under "Pre-printed" tray. Hosts — remember to return vendor badges to dropbox and sign the vendor log. We'll add this to today's visitor ledger for badge reconciliation.

riley: One more: Miguel asked about a power strip. There's one in AV-LOCKER 2. Miguel/Priya, please sign it out on the equipment log.
katie: I'll meet them at the loading bay at 13:25. If anyone needs a photo of the package label for records, frontdesk-bot can post it here.

frontdesk-bot: Photo of label posted to #internal-docs (link: https://redwood.docs/shipments/BE-445566). Reminder: return temp badges to dropbox. :white_check_mark:

sara: Perfect, thanks team!
